learning_outcomes.text: Knows the basic laws and principles of interpreter operation, using Matlab as an example.
Knows how data is organized in Matlab.
Has the ability to solve problematic professional tasks in the field of computer science.
Can effectively use computational software, using Matlab as an example.
Is aware of responsibility for their own work and readiness to comply with teamwork principles and take responsibility for jointly implemented tasks.

syllabus_topics: Laboratory exercises: Data types, mathematical operations, variables, program execution, graphics
Laboratory exercises: Matrix operations
Laboratory exercises: Conditional statements and loops
Laboratory exercises: Functions and recursion
Laboratory exercises: Elements of statistics (means, median, standard deviation, Gaussian plot)
Laboratory exercises: Geometric transformations in a plane
Laboratory exercises: Sorting methods
Laboratory exercises: Solving systems of linear equations
Laboratory exercises: Solving non-linear equations
Laboratory exercises: Interpolation and approximation
Laboratory exercises: Numerical integration
Laboratory exercises: Determining element characteristics
Laboratory exercises: Simulink, modeling and simulation of dynamic systems
Laboratory exercises: Signal analysis, feature extraction

Lectures: Programming in Matlab environment: defining variables, vectors and matrices, mathematical functions, signal generation, plotting, scripts, if-else constructs, loops, complex numbers, systems of linear equations, non-linear equations.
Lectures: Interpolation and approximation.
Lectures: Basics of Simulink package: libraries, result presentations, modeling and simulation of dynamic systems, solving differential equations.
Lectures: Signal analysis, feature extraction.
Lectures: Symbolic calculations.
Lectures: Presentation of other IT solutions based on similar principles as Matlab.
assessment_rules: The condition for passing the course is passing the laboratory exercises. The condition for passing the laboratory exercises is to complete the programs assigned by the instructor and pass a test. Passing the module is possible after passing all laboratory classes.
